title: Licence terms
patterns: can i share it with my team
response: The toolkit is a collection of installers for freely distributed, trial or vendor-supplied software, plus our own automation tools. You get a licence to use it in your own business; you cannot resell, rebrand or redistribute the package itself. Licensing each program for your client works the normal way.
followup: Do you have a specific use case in mind?

title: Commercial use
patterns: is it allowed in my shop
can i use it on client computers
response: Yes — it is built for commercial bench work in repair shops, IT support companies and freelance technician work. No per-client or per-machine licensing is required from us.
followup: Would you like the purchase link?

title: Personal use
patterns: can i use it for personal use
response: Absolutely. Plenty of buyers use it for their own machines, family PCs and side jobs. If it saves you one trip to a repair shop, it has already paid for itself.
followup: Anything else you'd like to check?

title: Machine limit
patterns: how many machines can i install it on
can i use it on unlimited computers
does it lock to one pc
response: There is no machine limit and no activation. The toolkit lives on your USB drive, so you use it on as many machines as you want, for as long as you want.

title: Interface language
response: Being straight with you: the automation panel's interface labels are in **Portuguese** in the current build — the screenshots on this page show exactly what you get. Program names, Windows itself and everything you install stay in your client's language. If the interface language is a dealbreaker, email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} before buying and we will show you the panel in detail.
